content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for IIIT Sri City Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 02-10-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IT Support Personnel posts at IIIT Sri City?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the IT Support Personnel positions at IIIT Sri City is October 2, 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What are the educational qualifications required for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Diploma or Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science & Engineering, Information Technology, Electronics & Communication Engineering, or a related discipline.

faq.question: Q3. How can I apply for the IIIT Sri City IT Support Personnel jobs?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. Ensure you send your complete bio-data and required documents before the deadline.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the job type for these positions?
faq.answer: The positions are on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q6. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies for IT Support Personnel roles.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the IT Support Personnel posts?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a Written Test, Skill Test, Interview, and Document Verification.

faq.question: Q8. Where is IIIT Sri City located?
faq.answer: IIIT Sri City is located in Chittoor, Andhra Pradesh.

faq.question: Q9. Can candidates from any state apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The notification does not specify any state-wise restrictions, but it is advisable to check the official notification for any specific eligibility related to domicile.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The link to the official notification PDF can be found in the "Important Links" section of this article.
